name: Multi-Field Weighted Full-Text Retrieval (Title 3x, Body 1x)
description: A match in a document title or product headline is far more indicative of relevance than a passing mention in the body text.
prompt:
A match in a document title or product headline is far more indicative of relevance than a passing mention in the body text.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: post_id, title, multi_field_score.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Search for 'wireless headphones': Title matches weighted 3.0x, Body matches weighted 1.0x
            WITH scored AS (
                SELECT 
                    post_id,
                    title,
                    ROUND(
                        (CASE WHEN title ILIKE '%wireless%' THEN 3.0 ELSE 0.0 END) +
                        (CASE WHEN title ILIKE '%headphones%' THEN 3.0 ELSE 0.0 END) +
                        (CASE WHEN body ILIKE '%wireless%' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) +
                        (CASE WHEN body ILIKE '%headphones%' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 2
                    ) AS multi_field_score
                FROM product_posts
            )
            SELECT 
                post_id,
                title,
                multi_field_score
            FROM scored
            WHERE multi_field_score > 0
            ORDER BY multi_field_score DESC;
why_it_fails: Concatenating title and body into a single column gives equal weight to all words.
